scope: V10/M9 macOS Close Window retains one live renderer/session; explicit Quit remains the discard/shutdown boundary. V10 stays Review for titlebar dragging and remaining chrome proof.

environment.appliesTo: The fifteen corrected snapshots. Historical before-fix recreated windows retain their original1280×800 bounds and viewport, visible in each embedded snapshot.

decision.Steve: Supports hide-on-close; existing renderer avoids a second transient state store; after challenge agrees hiding does not cancel prior authorization. Explicit Pause/Cancel and Quit stop their activities.
decision.Elena: Supports hide-on-close; source requirements originally left close vs quit implicit. After challenge rejects adding stop/cancel to close; exact semantics are now explicit. No blocking actual-diff findings.
decision.Morgan: Intercept macOS close only while not quitting, hide same window, restore/show/focus it on activation. Preserve existing actual-destruction and before-quit cleanup. Do not save drafts, dispatch or retry operations on hide/show.
decision.tradeoff: Music and authorized work continue while app is hidden. Quit remains explicit. Avoid renderer-state mirroring or secret draft persistence.

method: Current production renderer/preload with bundled actual main/services; disposable synthetic catalog, actual local safeStorage and null shared-key adapter. Initial fixture show suppression was removed before accepted close/reopen runs; current production ready-to-show remains unchanged.
Native CUA supplies all field edits, settings Save, Play/Pause, red close, CmdW, CmdM, app activation and CmdQ. Playwright launches and reads telemetry only.

Native Command-R installs a passive Audio-constructor observer retaining actual native Audio instances. No audio methods, duration getters or UI actions are substituted. Native window properties/events and renderer readback identify hidden and shown state.

To preserve a hidden observation, native Close is followed by read-only observer snapshots before the next AX read. AX reads can reactivate the app. An early combined Close/AX sequence records hide+show, not a stable hidden interval.

A controlled saveDJPlayback gate after sender/input guards holds one explicit settings submission and releases it as a failure. No server/provider mutation occurs. The second explicit Save succeeds through actual IPC/local storage.

Native CmdQ exits0. A second process reuses exactly the same disposable data; bootstrap skips seeding. Native Settings reads distinguish persisted cadence7 from discarded draft8 and persisted fade1.5 from discarded draft2.7. The queue restores paused.

independentActualDiffReview.Steve: support; no blocker; paid-provider continuation is source-inferred

checks.finalArtifactReview: Elena inspected final record, documentation and retained fixture states; no blocking issue. Her minor environment ambiguity is corrected by explicitly scoping1280×720 to the fifteen corrected snapshots and preserving historical1280×800 values.

limits: Same renderer identity establishes continued state ownership; native draft cases cover General cadence/transition settings, pending failure/retry and local silent audio, not every radio/provider form or concurrent operation.

Actual paid-provider continuation while hidden and cancellation during real provider work on Quit are source-reviewed, not billed runtime tests. The fixture scheduler is stopped; no live provider or server is contacted.
The first lifecycle fixture suppressed ready-to-show and reopened hidden. It is preserved as an adapter limitation, not a production failure. Accepted close/reopen cases remove that substitution.

Pointer dragging produced no move event in three attempts. One attempt selected content, so coordinate/capture ambiguity remains; no app drag defect or pass is inferred. A screenshot activated macOS window-sharing chrome; normal traffic-light appearance and full desktop imagery remain separate.
CUA reported timeout/noWindowsAvailable after some successful pre-fix closes. Actual closed events, no-window state and continuing owned observer distinguish successful close from process failure.

Quit exit0 is directly observed; the final polling snapshot can predate before-quit, so no saved event-log proof of shutdown cleanup is claimed. Cleanup follows source review and prior integration evidence.
No VoiceOver, audible-quality, uncoached-listener, Intel/other-macOS/display, signed package or whole-goal acceptance pass. Outside the dated90-record provenance audit.
